notes: YouthWorks rules apply. If you are under 18, you need a Maryland work permit.
name: MediaWorks Summer Intensive
what_you_do: A paid summer program that mixes media arts training with college and career development.
who_can_apply: Baltimore City youth ages 14 to 21 apply through YouthWorks. The program also works with the Baltimore County summer jobs program, so county teens should ask.
pay_detail: Paid for 120 hours over five weeks. The rate is not stated on this page.
deadline_text: YouthWorks application period: Jan 4, 2027 to Feb 27, 2027. Program runs June 28 to July 30, 2027. Spots are filled first-come, first-served.
how_to_apply: Apply to YouthWorks. Once accepted, email the Wide Angle programs team your YouthWorks Verification Receipt so they can add you.
